description.en: Alpha preview for DSH Web 0.2.1-alpha.2: adds collapsible cross-project pinned Session groups alongside Workspace, using native pins without changing project ownership or cwd. Published on npm as @umialpha/dsh-session-groups@0.1.0. Public installation, removal, and Workspace restoration passed smoke testing; real mouse drag-and-drop acceptance remains pending.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH Web 0.2.1-alpha.2 的 alpha 预览版：在工作区同级区域提供可折叠的跨项目置顶 Session 分组，复用原生置顶，不改变项目归属或 cwd。已以 @umialpha/dsh-session-groups@0.1.0 发布到 npm。公开安装、移除和工作区恢复 smoke 验证通过；真实鼠标拖放仍待验收。
